description: The bar chart compares the sample counts of essays categorized by genre, with each genre having two types of essays: Open and Cons. The horizontal axis represents the essay genres, which are Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository. The vertical axis indicates the sample count, with values ranging from 0 to 130. For each genre, there are two bars side by side, one for Open and one for Cons. The Open bars are colored in light blue, while the Cons bars are in light pink. The Argumentative genre has 79 Open essays and 122 Cons essays. The Narrative genre has 80 Open essays and 87 Cons essays. The Descriptive genre has 68 Open essays and 100 Cons essays. The Expository genre has the highest number of Cons essays at 130, with 62 Open essays. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
